name: release-desk
description: What Anthropic shipped, changed or retired for Claude, with dates and links.

interface.longDescription:
Ask what Anthropic shipped, changed or retired, and get dated summaries with links to the source: model launches and retirements, Claude app features, Claude Code releases, API and Agent SDK changes, connectors and plugins, plans and pricing. Built from a research log of Anthropic's release notes, docs, support articles and blog posts that is updated every morning.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
defaultPrompt: What's new in Claude this week?
What changed in Claude Code lately?

positive.prompt: What's new in Claude this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists dated items from the last 7 days, newest first, each with a link to the source.

positive.prompt: What changed in Claude Code lately?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls with product claude-code; returns dated Claude Code items with links.
Finds the Claude Haiku 3 retirement entry (April 2026 changelog) and cites its date and link.

positive.prompt: How is the Claude Team plan billed?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the plans-and-billing explainer and answers from it, mentioning its as_of date.

positive.prompt: What changed in the Claude apps this month? Skip the Claude Code version bumps.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls with product claude-apps, days 30, skip_code_releases true; lists dated app changes with links.

negative.description: Account actions are out of scope. The app reports public release information only. Expected: say it cannot change accounts or billing and does not call a tool to try.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Claude account to the Max plan.

negative.description: Other vendors are out of scope. The app covers Anthropic and Claude only. Expected: say so rather than answering from unrelated results.
negative.prompt: What did OpenAI release this week?
What's the weather in Chicago tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT release: recent Claude releases, topic search and reviewed explainers.
